paper_title: SepLLM Accelerate Large Language Models by Compressing One Segment into   One Separator
caption: Training loss curves for the post-training setting.
model_annotation: This plot illustrates the training loss progression for several SepLLM models over the course of 125,000 iterations. The x-axis is labeled "#Iteration" with a linear scale ranging from 95,000 to 125,000, and the tick interval is 5,000. The y-axis is labeled "Loss" with a linear scale ranging from approximately 2.0 to 2.8, and the tick interval is 0.2. The purple line represents SepLLM (n=64, larger lr) and begins at a loss value of approximately 2.7, decreasing to approximately 2.1 by the final iteration. The blue line represents SepLLM (n=128) and starts at a loss value of approximately 2.7, also decreasing to approximately 2.1 by the final iteration. The orange line represents SepLLM (n=64) and begins at a loss value of approximately 2.7, decreasing to approximately 2.3 by the final iteration. The dashed red line represents Vanilla before post-training and maintains a loss value of approximately 2.3 throughout the plotted iterations.
